ValidationRule.description: Status of Acceptors with record type “Edenred POS” cannot go back to “Created” or “Demo”
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Edenred_POS' && ISCHANGED( ER_Status__c ) && ( ( NOT(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(ER_Status__c)) = 'Created') && !ISBLANK(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(ER_Status__c))) && TEXT(ER_Status__c) = 'Demo' ) ||( !ISBLANK(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(ER_Status__c))) && TEXT(ER_Status__c) = 'Created' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot go back to “Created” or “Demo” status
